newsitem.title: USA: Equity capital of US banks hits 50-year high--FDIC.
newsitem.headline: Equity capital of US banks hits 50-year high--FDIC.

text.p: By at least one widely followed measure, the U.S. banking industry is healthier than it has been in a generation, regulators said on Friday.

While bank profits dropped slightly in the third quarter to $13.2 billion, the Federal Deposit Insurance Corp reported that bank equity capital increased to $370.4 billion from $344.1 billion a year earlier. That capital represented 8.31 percent of total bank assets, a 50-year high, the FDIC said.
"The overall health of the banking industry is extraordinarily strong," FDIC chairman Ricki Helfer said at a news conference here.
